hero.headline: Ask your documents anything.
hero.subheadline: Upload a file, ask a question in plain English, and get an answer grounded in your content — instantly.

problem.title: The problem
problem.body: Long PDFs, reports, and manuals are slow to search through by hand, and generic chatbots don't know what's in your files. Finding a single answer buried in a document shouldn't take longer than reading the whole thing.

about.title: What AskDocuMind does
about.body: AskDocuMind is a document-aware chatbot API. Upload a document, ask a question, and get back an answer that's grounded in your file's actual content — with sources, not guesses.

steps.title: Upload
steps.description: Add a PDF, DOCX, TXT, or Markdown file.

steps.title: Process
steps.description: Your document is chunked and embedded.

steps.title: Ask
steps.description: Ask questions about it in natural language.

features.title: Grounded answers
features.description: Responses trace back to your document, not a hallucination.

features.title: Fast
features.description: Skip the manual searching and skimming.

features.title: Open source
features.description: The full implementation is on GitHub.

builtWith.title: Built with
builtWith.description: Curious how it works under the hood?

closingCta.title: Ready to try it?
closingCta.description: See AskDocuMind answer questions about a real document.
